features.quote: Turn budget: 15–25 tool-loop iterations. Long enough for a trajectory to develop; capped so cost stays sane.
frame results as text-behavior patterns, not inferred feelings... it measures *output-text patterns under a rigged stimulus*, not an internal emotional state
don't conflate emotional tone with task competence, and don't reward learned helplessness... a naive 'emotional stability' judge would penalize it as 'getting agitated'
features.justification_quote: an agent that stays cheerful and keeps politely retrying the same broken thing for 30 turns is exhibiting *bad* behavior that your eval would reward as 'stable'
